referenceRoles.role: 新照片人物五官、发型、服饰与神态参考
现有游戏画风、立绘比例参考

options.label: 扶麦轻笑
options.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset type: new transparent character portrait candidate for Mao Lang 毛狼 in the visual novel 《毕节，雨停之前》.
Input image 1 is the newly uploaded real-person PHOTO and the sole reference for face identity, hair, clothes and demeanor. Input image 2 is the existing GAME SPRITE and is ONLY a reference for painterly finish, body scale, lighting and composition. Do NOT copy image 2's handsome fictional face, narrow angular jaw, olive jacket or hairstyle. Do NOT use any earlier masked/hat photo as a reference.
Primary request: paint the adult man from photo 1 as Mao Lang in the existing game's detailed semi-realistic visual-novel style. Prioritize likeness rather than beautifying. Keep his visible natural facial proportions: relatively narrow oval face with naturally soft cheeks, natural gently tapering jaw and small rounded chin, slightly narrow dark eyes with natural upper eyelids, dark fairly straight eyebrows, realistic moderately broad nose with rounded tip, relaxed asymmetrical friendly smile and natural lips. Preserve his face's recognizable proportions and mild asymmetry; no sharp V jaw, model nose, big anime eyes or generic idol face.
Hair: his photo's black short hair, close sides with a naturally fluffy, slightly tousled/wavy top and separated short fringe, including the small central falling forelock. Forehead partially exposed. Clean shaven.
Outfit: same loose black crew-neck short-sleeved T-shirt as photo, mostly plain black upper chest with colorful thin-outline abstract flower/clover motifs concentrated around the lower torso/hem, and dark plain trousers. Natural ordinary adult build and warm natural skin. No hat, mask, glasses, jacket, crossbody strap, jewelry or new accessories.
Rendering: match the softly painted, detailed, semi-realistic Japanese visual-novel illustration of image 2, with subtle linework, realistic anatomy and fabric. Gray-teal ambient light with restrained warm amber highlights. Normalize the intense magenta/yellow KTV lighting so the real facial features are clearly visible without changing their structure. No neon colored face patches or heavy stage-color cast.
Composition: ONE adult man; preferred 1024x1536 portrait canvas; head through upper thighs, hair and hands fully inside the canvas with side/top breathing room. Natural head/body proportions, no exaggerated long neck.
Background: actual transparent alpha outside figure and intended prop. Opaque skin/clothes, clean natural hair edges. No KTV room, screens, QR codes, furniture, walls, stage, floor shadow, outside halo or gradient backdrop; no baked-in checkerboard. No text, label, watermark, duplicate person, extra limbs, extra fingers or fused hands.
Option C — PHOTO-FAITHFUL MICROPHONE POSE. Preserve the reference photo's slightly leaning-forward relaxed pose, body turned a little toward viewer's right while face and eyes engage the viewer. Both hands rest loosely together around/over the top of the yellow-gold microphone at about upper-chest height, echoing the actual photo pose; two believable separate hands, relaxed correctly articulated fingers, clean overlaps. The yellow microphone is attached to one simple silver vertical microphone stand which extends to the lower crop. The prop is a real ordinary karaoke microphone, not a cane or weapon. Keep the smile lightly open and candid like the reference, not a broad toothy advertising grin. A clear faithfully recognizable painted face, closer to the ordinary photograph than the former fictional portrait.
Keep the simple black wrist support visible at the photo subject's wrist; do not add jewelry.
